achievements.Brief Description: Low power current supplies are crucial in microampere devices . We designed a low power current reference circuit with low TC (39 ppm post layout) for applications in data acquisition in ECG .

achievements.Brief Description: Nano Navigator is an autonomous Micromouse robot designed to efficiently solve complex mazes using a modified Trémaux algorithm with a DFS approach. Implemented in C++ on Arduino, the robot utilizes custom stack and queue libraries to enhance path exploration and decision-making.

achievements.Brief Description: We developed a 3 Omni wheel holonomic robot to create complex art on surface with pen attached to it by extracting and manipulating contours using ROS, OpenCV, Gazebo and Arduino with help of microcontroller, with the robot moving through localization through Aruco markers.

achievements.Brief Description: We developed a line follower capable of following white or black lines using IR sensor array with ability to detect colors using sensors to make decisions based upon the color and capable of back tracing its path using Arduino microcontroller programming.
